meta.name: Sangamesh Girish Dandin
meta.subtitle: I build intelligent systems that find, fight, and fix threats — where machine learning meets offensive security.

paragraphs: I'm an MSc AI student at National College of Ireland, Dublin, working at the intersection of machine learning and cybersecurity. My work focuses on building systems that are not just intelligent — but defensively aware.

From multi-LLM prompt injection defenses to malware classifiers, I ship full-stack AI products with real security applications. I hold a PNPT candidacy through TCM Security and actively hunt bugs on Bugcrowd as n0xvector.
I believe the best security tools are built by people who understand both the attack and the model. That's the space I live in.

projects.name: TriageAI
projects.tagline: LLM-powered SOC alert triage engine with MITRE ATT&CK mapping
projects.description: Ingests SIEM alerts, deduplicates via FAISS vector search, maps to MITRE ATT&CK framework, scores with Groq llama-3.3-70b-versatile, and surfaces results via a React/Vite/TailwindCSS dashboard with PDF export.

projects.name: RedTeam Copilot AI
projects.tagline: Agentic pentesting assistant with 4-stage LLM pipeline
projects.description: Autonomous red team assistant running OSINT → Port Scan → CVE Match → Report pipeline. Generates dark-themed PDF pentest reports automatically. Built with FastAPI and Groq API.

projects.name: ZeroInject Shield
projects.tagline: Multi-LLM ensemble defense against prompt injection attacks
projects.description: A 4-stage multi-agent prompt injection defense pipeline using consensus voting across multiple LLMs. Built with FastAPI backend, React frontend, and Groq API. Targets SaaS and small business LLM deployments.

projects.name: ByteHunter
projects.description: Two-model pipeline using EMBER 2018 LightGBM (89.67% accuracy, 95.40% AUC) for threat scoring and XGBoost on Microsoft BIG-2015 for malware family classification. Full SHAP explainability, React/Vite/FastAPI/Docker stack.

projects.name: MailGuard AI
projects.tagline: Email impersonation detection with SPF/DKIM/DMARC validation
projects.description: Stylometric classifier trained on the Enron corpus. Chrome Extension integrates into Gmail with real-time SPF/DKIM/DMARC validation. 72% accuracy, 84% impostor precision.

projects.name: ZeroTrace AI
projects.tagline: Threat intelligence platform with exploit prediction
projects.description: Full-stack cybersecurity threat intelligence platform ingesting CVE data from NVD, CISA KEV, ExploitDB. XGBoost for exploit probability, Groq API for NLP summarization, FAISS vector search, Streamlit/FastAPI/PostgreSQL/Docker.

projects.name: Predictive Patch Scheduler
projects.description: Processes 500+ CVE records with CVSS-based risk scoring, improving prioritization accuracy by ~35% over manual methods. RESTful API via FastAPI for integration with external security tools.

projects.name: VulnXploit Scanner
projects.tagline: Full-stack web vulnerability scanner with CVE matching
projects.description: Automated port scanning across 65,000+ ports, reducing manual assessment time by ~60%. Real-time CVE database matching and PoC exploit generation to streamline pentesting workflows.
